name: medical-mcp
description: Medical reference tool providing drug information, interaction checking and clinical literature search. Queries authoritative public sources including FDA drug database, RxNorm nomenclature and PubMed medical literature. No patient data involved.

tools.name: search_drugs
tools.description: Searches the FDA drug database by name, active ingredient or condition. Returns drug details including approved uses, contraindications and manufacturer.

tools.name: check_interactions
tools.description: Checks for known interactions between two or more drugs using RxNorm. Returns severity classification and clinical recommendation for each interaction found.

tools.name: get_drug_details
tools.description: Returns detailed information for a drug by NDC code or RxNorm identifier including mechanism of action, dosage forms, side effects and black box warnings.

tools.name: search_literature
tools.description: Searches PubMed for peer-reviewed clinical literature by keyword, condition or drug name. Returns abstracts and DOI links.
